surface_1.notes: Composition matches (path from the foreground to the cottage, full moon, hooded figure on the path). Cottage is a clean box, not crumbling rubble masonry; the framing oaks are blobs; grass is too uniform and saturated; the ref's sky is a lighter, mistier blue.

surface_2.notes: Two seated knights in red-stained armour around a red fire. Knights read as mannequins with pink-lit armour; the fire cone is too saturated; the ref's dark forest with the teal sky window and distant tower is missing.

surface_3.notes: Red hoods and a ruined arch are there, but the ref is a dense, overgrown painted ruin under gnarled trees and a grey sky; ours is a green field with a blocky arch and pines.

surface_4.notes: Two hooded figures walking up a narrow alley into violet haze with a castle silhouette ahead: close in mood. Walls lack the ref's stone texture and cobbles; the castle silhouette is simpler.

surface_5.notes: Pink moon over a blue night with rocky walls. The ruined tower and the magenta-robed figure drifted out of frame; the moon is too saturated and hard-edged.

surface_6.notes: Crimson sky, black spires, distant spired castle, lone figure, purple mist sea. The mist reads as flat glossy liquid instead of billowing cloud; the sky is too bright red; the castle is too big and close.

surface_7.notes: Red-hooded figures with a torch among green spires. Fog is neon green, the robes are cartoon red, and the spires lack the pale weathered rock of the ref.

surface_8.notes: Gothic cathedral under stars, nebula and planets, with kneeling red figures. The cathedral is blocky and salmon; the nebula is too red and strong; the rocky canyon walls lack detail.

surface_9.notes: Red moon, black spires, ruined arch, snowy blue ground. Clouds too saturated red; the monolith tower is cropped at the right; the snow is smooth purple instead of rough blue drifts.

surface_10.notes: Knight resting under a huge tree: the shot is far too dark, the knight barely reads and the full moon is out of frame. Needs a full reframe.

surface_11.notes: Broken arch framing a keep with a crescent and a hooded figure. Missing the red sunset light on the mountains and keep; the horned skull is out of frame; the palette is a flat blue.

gloaming_1.notes: Red moon, green windows and green light on the ground. The manor is a boxy symmetric block instead of a tall gothic house; the dead tree does not frame the left; the sky is still more orange than the ref's crimson-maroon.

gloaming_2.notes: Spired castle with green windows at the end of a cobbled road. The ref's castle is massive and close above a raised flagstone causeway with stone curbs and water channels; ours is distant and spiky in pink haze. This rework was not finished.

gloaming_3.notes: Aurora over dark pines with the skeleton and golden skull, but as a wide shot; the ref is a low close-up of the skeleton holding the golden skull.

gloaming_4.notes: Robed wizards and the timber house are there, but seen from behind with the orange house dominating; the ref has huge-hatted wizards facing the camera in deep violet light.

gloaming_5.notes: Sandstone round towers, starry sky, bright green hill. The purple path is mostly hidden; the pink horizon glow is weaker; the camera stands further back than the ref.

gloaming_6.notes: White wizard by dark water under a crescent. The wizard is small and glows blue; the ref's figure fills two thirds of the frame over choppy teal water.

gloaming_7.notes: Knight on a rock in a lake between pines. The knight is tiny, the moon glow blows out the sky, and the water is violet instead of clear teal-green.

gloaming_8.notes: Lanterns, cottages and a purple sky. The ref is a close storybook lane with curled roofs, round stained glass, flowers and a lavender cobble path under a big canopy.

gloaming_9.notes: Huge tree and knight, but the canopy fills the sky and the knight is tiny; the ref shows the trunk at the right, open violet sky with a crescent, and the knight close in the foreground.

gloaming_10.notes: Lady in a red gown with long blond hair and a blue butterfly, huge pale green planet in an olive sky, glowing pool and walkway. The dark round tower is out of frame; the pool shape is crude; the camera is further back than the ref.

gloaming_11.notes: Orange-and-green cone tents, gnomes with green hats and blue packs walking toward a deep blue sea with black spires under a white moon. The nearest tent is too close; the left cliff and weeping trees are weaker; the moon is less blinding.

gloaming_12.notes: Log cabin with two figures on a tall rock pillar under a blue moon. The pillar is bluish rock rather than streaked green moss; the cabin is small in frame; the ref's cloud-and-star sky is busier.

gloaming_13.notes: The only daylight place: turquoise lake, jagged snow-streaked peaks, white clouds, sun glare. The ref's vantage is higher over a bigger lake with the sun disc in frame and a visible glacier; our pines are tinted blue.

gloaming_14.notes: Tree houses built into giant trunks with cone roofs and round amber windows. The curving orange flagstone path and wooden rail are mostly out of frame; the ref is denser and darker.

gloaming_15.notes: Crowned king on a stone throne with a green-lit face and raised hand, dark towers and glowing vines. The vines are too bright neon; the king is small in frame; the ref's stone is darker and more detailed.

gloaming_16.notes: Mossy green troll with pointed ears and one glowing yellow eye in a wooden boat on dark swamp water by a pale tree. The ref is a close-up; ours is mid-distance and the face over-glows.
